title: Mana, mana potions and skill costs
changes: New blue Mana bar under Stamina. Spells cost mana: the whole Wizard book, plus holy, spirit, jutsu and nature skills of the other heroes. Magic raises your mana and how fast it refills.
Fighters live on Stamina: Knight, Ninja, Archer and Barbarian pay for sword swings, dashes, shouts and traps with it, and refill it faster than the Wizard.
Mana potions: press V to drink one (refills half your mana). Monsters and chests drop them, and Old Morwen sells them next to her healing potions.
Every skill was rebalanced around its cooldown plus its stamina and/or mana cost; the skill tree shows both.
